recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被纖維化間質填滿，裡面可見多個小巢狀與腺管樣排列的上皮細胞團，核深染擁擠，完全沒有造血細胞，符合乳腺管癌轉移至骨髓。
features: Intertrabecular space between thick bony trabeculae filled with fibroblastic desmoplastic stroma
Multiple small cohesive nests and cord-like or gland-like clusters of epithelial cells
Crowded hyperchromatic nuclei with moderate cytoplasm
No residual hematopoietic cells or fat in the involved space
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an intertrabecular space filled with desmoplastic fibrous stroma containing multiple small cohesive nests and cords of epithelial cells, some with vague gland-like arrangement. The tumor cells have crowded hyperchromatic nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, with retraction clefts around the nests. Residual hematopoiesis is not identified in the involved area. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow, compatible with the patient's known invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast.

ddx.vs: Lobular carcinoma cells are discohesive, often single-file, and lose E-cadherin, unlike these cohesive nests.
Morphology overlaps, so GATA3/ER/HER2 positivity supports breast origin versus TTF-1, CDX2 or PSA/NKX3.1 for other sites.
Megakaryocytes are large single cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei, CD61-positive, not keratin-positive nests.
